The Clothing Line

Pine & Ember Mercantile

Pine & Ember is our clothing line. Everything in it carries one small mark: a navy pine rising from a burnt orange crescent moon. We drew it to sit quietly on a chest, a blanket corner, a folded scarf.

The mark

We drew it small, the way the old outdoor brands put one mark on a chest and left it at that. It stands for something rooted and quiet, lit by a warm glow.

The line

Three groups, one mark. The printed pieces sell through our Redbubble shop, and the embroidered pieces sell through our Pine and Ember shop on Printify. We add pieces as we finish and review them.

No. 1 · Apparel

Tees & Hoodies

Tees and hoodies, the mark small on the chest. The printed mark tee is in the Redbubble shop now, alongside our other apparel designs. We also made a back print tee, with the mark large across the back. The hoodies below are the embroidered ones, stitched in thread.

View the chest mark tee View the back print tee
No. 2 · The Home

Blankets

The mark blanket is in the shop now. It is a velveteen plush throw in deep navy, with the mark at the center and a fine cream and ember frame around it. We made it in three sizes, from $24.99.

View the mark blanket
No. 3 · The Season

Scarves

We have two scarves in the shop now. One carries a single large mark on cream, drawn for winter. The other repeats small cream pine marks across deep navy.

View the cream statement scarf View the deep navy repeat scarf

If a group is not in the shop yet, it is still on the worktable, not forgotten.

Where to find it

We sell the printed Pine & Ember pieces through our Redbubble shop, PixelsandPrint, where the mark tee sits alongside our other apparel designs. The embroidered pieces are in the next section, in our Pine and Ember shop on Printify. We drew the artwork and looked it over before it went up.
